name: Pumpkin

description: Pumpkin is a Minecraft server written entirely in Rust, aiming to be fast, efficient and extensible. It supports Java Edition and Bedrock Edition clients. https://github.com/Pumpkin-MC/Pumpkin

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash

apt update
apt install -y curl ca-certificates

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

ARCH=$(uname -m)
case "${ARCH}" in
    x86_64|amd64)  ASSET="pumpkin-X64-Linux" ;;
    aarch64|arm64) ASSET="pumpkin-ARM64-Linux" ;;
    *) echo "Unsupported architecture: ${ARCH}"; exit 1 ;;
esac

if [ -z "${PUMPKIN_VERSION}" ] || [ "${PUMPKIN_VERSION}" == "latest" ]; then
    DOWNLOAD_URL="https://github.com/Pumpkin-MC/Pumpkin/releases/latest/download/${ASSET}"
else
    DOWNLOAD_URL="https://github.com/Pumpkin-MC/Pumpkin/releases/download/${PUMPKIN_VERSION}/${ASSET}"
fi

echo -e "Downloading Pumpkin from: ${DOWNLOAD_URL}"
rm -f pumpkin
curl -fL -o pumpkin "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"

if [ ! -s pumpkin ]; then
    echo "Download failed."
    exit 1
fi

chmod +x pumpkin

echo -e "Install Completed"

variables.description: Message of the day shown in the server list (Java and Bedrock).

variables.name: Online Mode
variables.description: Authenticate Java players with Mojang. Allowed values: "true" or "false"

variables.name: World Name
variables.description: Name of the main world directory.

variables.name: Whitelist
variables.description: Enable the server whitelist. Allowed values: "true" or "false"

variables.name: Bedrock Enabled
variables.description: Enable Bedrock Edition (NetherNet) support. Allowed values: "true" or "false"

variables.name: Bedrock Port
variables.description: UDP port for Bedrock clients. Add an allocation for this port to the server.
